motion.name: selection-lift
motion.value: 0.25 world units * (1 - exp(-elapsed_seconds * 18)); redraw window 350 ms
motion.purpose: Native GPU selection response; Reduce motion applies the lift immediately. This is a Rust scene expression, not a CSS animation.

motion.name: optional-float
motion.purpose: Explicit Float experiment; paused while unfocused and disabled by Reduce motion. Labels and contact shadows remain stationary.

headline.purpose: Tenshu heading; embedded IBM Plex Sans Regular. Size strings in DESIGN.md are Iced logical pixels.

caption.purpose: Metrics, notices and catalog context; no CSS font stack or extra loaded weight is implied.

narrative.overview: This is a descriptive inventory of the standalone Iced/wgpu prototype at source commit e72aacfc9d093a5e1af84cb10114a0597b90cb8f, not a new identity or global Tenshu design policy. The fixed-camera floor makes synthetic Cube containers tangible; ordinary desktop controls and the right-hand catalog carry names, network identity and actions. Orange connects creation, selection and preview. IBM Plex Sans preserves the existing Tenshu type identity.
keyCharacteristics: A dominant 3D floor paired with a persistent text catalog.
Dark default and switchable light mode; custom warm label/action treatments over standard Iced themes.
Network identity in both geometry color and readable text.
Explicit synthetic-data language and CPU/redraw measurement limits.

rules.name: The Text-Supported Identity Rule
rules.body: Every catalog entry names its network. Color alone never carries the catalog's network or backup meaning.

rules.name: The Single-Face Rule
rules.body: Preserve the embedded regular IBM Plex Sans identity when extending this prototype; do not infer extra loaded weights from heading roles.

rules.name: The Catalog Continuity Rule
rules.body: The regular catalog remains available when object labels are reduced or absent at higher counts.

dos: Do retain text-supported network and protection identity alongside 3D color.
Do use the regular embedded IBM Plex Sans and the observed native units.
Do keep the catalog available at scene densities where on-floor labels disappear.
Do label synthetic actions and measurement scope as explicitly as the current lab.
Do treat this inventory as a local source snapshot and recheck source when the prototype changes.
donts: Don't promote this lab's fixed layout or inherited Iced blue controls into global Tenshu rules.
Don't translate shader material vectors into asserted UI hex colors or contact shading into CSS shadows.
Don't represent selection/preview as authentication, or redraw cadence as GPU performance.
Don't canonize compact overlap, missing focus/AT proof, rectangular shader clipping or absent fallback as intended future behavior.
